summary: Iteration 262 — Verified the EXTENSION of the Qoyod identity diagnostics (limit=10 instead of 5, new sample fields type/status/active/archived/archived_at/category/price + customer phone/email/type/archived, plus `raw_first_row` exposing every field Qoyod sent for the first row up to 50 keys) and the corresponding QYD-GO frontend extension (6-column products table, 5-column customers table, two collapsible <details> with testid 'diag-products-raw' + 'diag-customers-raw'). pytest /app/backend/tests/test_qoyod_identity_diagnostics.py = 11/11 PASS (including the brand-new `test_raw_first_row_exposes_hidden_archived_field` which is the literal user repro: archived_at + custom_field_x must surface). Live HTTP smoke: GET /api/integrations/qoyod/diagnostics/identity on admin@hesab.app returns 200 with the EXACT new shape — products.endpoint='GET /products?page=1&limit=10', customers.endpoint='GET /customers?page=1&limit=10', meta=null, sample=[], raw_first_row=null (because in this preview the Qoyod key is in qoyod_unauthorized state — the expected partial-failure path documented in iter261 hand-off). api_key_fingerprint='08cef7386398' (sha256[:12] only, raw key never appears in response). Frontend smoke on QYD-GO page after running diagnostics confirmed every required testid renders: qoyod-identity-diagnostics-card, btn-run-identity-diag, diag-mezan-base-url, diag-mezan-fingerprint, diag-queried-at, diag-products, diag-customers, diag-confirm-identity, btn-activate-production. The conditional testids diag-products-table / diag-customers-table / diag-products-raw / diag-customers-raw are correctly ABSENT on the current 401 path and only render when products/customers .ok=true (verified in source code QoyodGoLive.jsx lines 281-330 + 349-393); the pytest covers the ok=true branch exhaustively. Body contains 'qoyod_unauthorized' rose-text error per spec.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 262 verifies the EXTENSION of identity diagnostics: limit=10 (not 5), new sample fields including archived/archived_at, and raw_first_row exposing every Qoyod key. pytest entry: /app/backend/tests/test_qoyod_identity_diagnostics.py (11 tests, all green). The admin@hesab.app preview tenant's Qoyod key is in qoyod_unauthorized state (401) for both /products and /customers — this is the expected condition and means the conditional UI elements (diag-products-table, diag-customers-table, diag-products-raw, diag-customers-raw) won't render live; pytest covers the success branch instead. rca of the issue: N/A — feature extension works as specified. The diagnostic now gives the operator everything they asked for: 10 rows instead of 5, full field breakdown per row including archived flags, AND a collapsible raw_first_row to inspect any hidden fields Qoyod sends (custom_field_x, kind, etc.). The original user concern ("Qoyod UI shows zero but API returns 38") can now be triaged by inspecting whether the sample products have archived=true OR by expanding raw_first_row to look for any field that would hide them from the Qoyod UI (archived_at, draft/status, type).
